limits: No per-car visual identity: RenderInstance carries no colour or material override and the session ships one car model, so every car wears the same livery.
Particle and skid sources are caller-supplied, so a field emits only for the cars the caller asks for; the diagnostic asks for none.
Cross-process image comparison is not bit-stable for this renderer; the repeat check is within one process.
Renderer half only: the driving window still runs the single-car session runtime, and standings, gaps and penalties in the HUD remain to do.
One prepared session and one camera; other cameras and larger fields are not separately captured.
scope: Renderer draws a whole field: per-car instances, explicit viewer, and mirror contents; verified by an offscreen field capture
